svg.title: Find your path. New to AI: start with Modules 00–02, aim for CCAO-F; Business or knowledge worker: start with Modules 03–05, aim for CCAO-F; Software or DevOps engineer: start with Modules 03–06, aim for CCAR-F; Security or DevSecOps engineer: start with Module 12, aim for Skills path; Solution or enterprise architect: start with Module 13, aim for CCAR-P; Technical leader: start with Modules 13 and 15, aim for Skills path.
